infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Spark requires camera access to capture physique check-in photos and coach avatars.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Spark requires microphone access for voice coaching notes and audio logs.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Spark requires photo library access to choose workout and progress photos.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Spark requires location access to track outdoor running, cycling, and GPS activity routes.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Spark needs access to read your workouts, heart rate, and activity metrics.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Spark needs permission to save scheduled workouts to your Apple Watch and Apple Health.
